request: Does the sofa colour go with the floor? Explain the visible palette and one optional small improvement. Do not change anything.

reply.message:
Yes—the muted sage sofa works well with the floor, which appears warm grey-beige in this render. Both are subdued, so the contrast feels gentle rather than stark.

The cream walls and sandy rug keep the palette light; walnut and oak add warmth, while terracotta seating and brass provide earthy accents. The sage kitchen cabinet also ties the spaces together.

One optional small improvement: a slightly deeper terracotta shade on the lounge chair would give the soft palette a little more definition. Nothing has been changed.
